messages:
anya: Quick check — can we do the full dry run this Wed 10am PT? Need to lock speakers + backup demo flow. Plan: pick final abstract, confirm slides, rehearse run-of-show, test inbound lead routing.
rachel: Wed 10am works for me. I'll confirm speakers.
kevin: I can do 10am. I'm fine as backup demo lead if needed.
oliver: Can we also test VPC/private deployment demo fallback? last time demo failed on auth.
sam: +1. I'll bring the `fallback-playbook.md` and set up a staged endpoint. Also can we test routing to SFDC queue?
rachel: Yes — marketing->sales routing: test form -> webhook -> hubspot/sf mapping. I'll make test leads.
anya: draft run-of-show — paste below, react with :thumbsup: if okay or edit.

```
10:00 - 10:05 Intro (Anya)
10:05 - 10:20 Benchmarks & cost narrative (Rachel)
10:20 - 10:35 Demo: hosted -> dedicated fallback (Kevin)
10:35 - 10:45 Q&A + lead capture walkthrough (Oliver)
10:45 - 10:50 Close + CTA (Anya)
```

oliver: Suggest adding 2-min segment about data residency for enterprise.
rachel: added to slide 6.
kevin: For demo fallback, we need pre-baked short prompts to trigger fallback. I'll commit them to repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/webinar-fallback
marketing-bot: Reminder: slides due Tue 5pm PT. (automated)
sam: For lead routing test, I'll create test form and share webhook URL here: https://hooks.example.com/test/abc123 — please don't post real creds
anya: Good. Also rehearsals: two runs — technical (full demo) Tue 5:30pm PT and dress run Wed 9am PT. Can everyone confirm?
rachel: I'll be at both.
kevin: Prefer Tue 5:30 only, Wed morning is tight, but I'll join if possible.
oliver: I'll do both.
anya: Perfect. Last: inbound lead routing escalation — if SF fails, leads go to shared inbox marketing+sales. sam, can you add auto-tag `webinar-inbound`?
sam: Done. tag added and a sample lead posted.
anya: thanks. Closing — I'll update the run doc and share canonical slides link. https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/abc
rachel: :thumbsup:
